name: Necromancer: the Crypt Plague passive makes Lichfrost apply two Crypt Plague stacks (#1856)
contract: #1856 names 500117 and 800108, neither of which a player can hold: neither has a CharacterAdvancement row, trainer, class_spell, module grant or triggering spell; each sits only on skill line 82 with AcquireMethod 0. 500117 is ranked 'Spec Passive Visual Show' (a tooltip carrier) and 800108 is a legacy 15 Runic Power active whose stack effect (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS) names 500339 with MiscValue 0. The mechanic 500117 describes, 'Your Lichfrost and Crypt Swarm now apply Crypt Plague', is delivered by the acquirable Death passive Crypt Plague 92121 (CharacterAdvancement 4034): 'Damage dealt by Crypt Swarm now applies 1 stack of Crypt Plague and Lichfrost applies 2 stacks.' Crypt Plague 570131 (PERIODIC_DAMAGE every 2000 ms, StackAmount 10) is the stacking disease. necromancer-rotting-flesh-level-passive covers Crypt Swarm's single stack; this case covers Lichfrost: without 92121 a Lichfrost hit applies no Crypt Plague, and with it one Lichfrost hit applies exactly two stacks.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let any Crypt Plague application land
CONTROL: no Crypt Plague without the passive
SETUP: the Crypt Plague passive is active
One Lichfrost hit adds exactly two stacks
